title: Forge phase-entered selected case v1 (an additive payload extension at event_schema 1)
description: The optional, absent-by-default payload field decision 0041 ruling 7 adds to phase/entered for a selecting seat. Legal at event_schema 1 under the amended rule in contracts/README.md, and never read by fold. Resume derives the same selection from the journaled strategy fact.

case.description: The strategy case resolved when this phase was entered, or default when the journal carried no matching triage result. Absent for a seat that does not select.
